text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days into the new year, I was out 
shopping in the commercial district with 
Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm waiting for Believe, who 
went to the hardware store to restock on 
sandpaper."
choice_data_list:
You use that sandpaper in the Trainer's 
office a lot, don't you?

You use that sandpaper in the Trainer's 
office a lot, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. I had trouble 
finding sandpaper with the grit I was 
looking for.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's the grit number that serves as the 
standard for coarseness. The lower the 
number, the coarser the grit.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Also... when I bought it, I got a raffle 
ticket, but—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
And... well, well! If it isn't the 
Umamusume missy who hit first prize last 
year! How about it, wanna test your luck 
again this year?!
choice_data_list: Since we're here, go on and give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe takes the handle of the raffle 
wheel and spins it. The result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I actually won.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer, after you.
choice_data_list:
No, no, no!? ...I told you this last year 
too, though!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No. Like I said last year, too, I'm not 
really one for traveling.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Then how about calling it a 'reward'? 
Compensation for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That is your reward from the Academy. 
This... is my reward to you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Work should come with appropriate 
compensation. Because that's what's 
necessary to maintain one's livelihood and 
keep on working.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Normally, there is nothing I could offer 
you. However, today, right now, I can.
choice_data_list:
By that logic, you should get a reward 
too!

By that logic, you should get a reward 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We're doing this work 'together.' So it 
makes no sense for only me to be 
rewarded!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (—Ah, she's not backing down at all...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "I understand the logic. ...I accept it."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I'll hold onto these tickets for now. And 
once my work reaches a good stopping 
point—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let's use it together, you and I. ...As 
the proper form of reward.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... Those two are kind of... unusual, 
aren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bel-chan! What's up... are ya in a 
pretty good mood today?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... I wonder. Though—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I was just thinking it's rare for you 
to lose a battle of endurance.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-san, after you.
choice_data_list:
No, no! I don't think I could finish it 
all...

No, no! I don't think I could finish it 
all...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not that big of an eater 
either—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...No, I see. Then, not me, but........."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I'm giving it to you. Here 
you go, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, what a splendid carrot 
hamburg steak! I'm delighted, but... why 
give it to me?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
They often share their rice bran pickled 
daikon with me. This is a token of my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"These crunchy treats? Believe-chan always 
finishes every single bite, you know."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That is... because it is delicious. 
...Extremely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
These nukazuke pickles clearly show true 
skill... I felt bad getting them for free 
all the time.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't this a heartwarming sight? 
Yoo-hoo! Welcome to the Accu-Tra room, 
Believe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Carrot Hamburger Steak, huh? Hmm, hmm. In 
that case, let's give this a shot—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's throw a potluck party~! Yeah, yeah☆

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So with that, here's what I brought!! A 
"Mystery Drink that changes flavors 
halfway through"~. Let's all have a blast 
with it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san is so stylish as always~! I can't 
wait to see what it tastes like!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
From me... um. It's "simmered ganmodoki 
tofu fritters". ...Please have some as a 
palate cleanser.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~♪ This looks like it'll leave a 
lovely, refreshing taste in your mouth. 
Simply delightful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Believe was able to spend a fun 
time at the party.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...That really is an incredible amount.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san—
choice_data_list:
I'd be more than happy if you could just 
spare one...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that figures. In that case, all 
that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Ah, right, with this much...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa, amazing, amazing, amazing!! You can 
really carve a butterfly out of a carrot!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"The plum blossoms and chrysanthemums are 
so pretty too...! Um, is it okay if I look 
at them a bit longer?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on! Did I hear someone 
around here is using magic~!?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, they're just decorative vegetable 
cuts, really...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That looks super fun!! Show Maya, show me 
too~♪

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (They just keep multiplying...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I only thought that since Grandma knows 
so many decorative cutting techniques, I 
should practice them too, but...)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Whoaa~!! That's amazingー!!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Oh well, whatever.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I'll simmer the chopped pieces 
together... and feed them to these kids.)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's better than getting a miss, but just 
one feels somewhat lonely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I had thought.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, a carrot! A whole carrot! Um, could 
I possibly have that, please...iku!?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text:
Please! I desperately need just one single 
carrot right this second...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah, yes, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so muuuuch~!! Umm, as a token of 
my gratitude... please accept this rock!! 
Now, if you'll excuse me~!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...What was that all about? Both that 
person... and this stone."
choice_data_list:
I wonder what that was all about... Wait, 
hm?

I wonder what that was all about... Wait, 
hm?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Elderly Person B
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!? Th-That stone! That vivid red! 
That is precisely what I have been 
searching for!!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Elderly Person B
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you please trade with me?! For this 
'little vial'! Please, pretty please~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And even after that, thanks to one elder 
after another appearing, the 'vial' turned 
into a 'parasol'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The parasol changed into a bouquet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the "bouquet" turned into a 
"coin," Believe began speaking rather 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about to become a whole 
'mansion.' Not that I can just move out of 
the dorms, though."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Starting off the New Year like this... 
That's a bit of bad luck...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Believe was left feeling a little 
crestfallen...
